    • submit

      public Deal submit(User buyer, String listingId, ListingType type, Double price, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end) throws SQLException
      Submits a buyer proposal or giveaway claim; it starts as Pending.

      A giveaway claim is a pending request; only seller acceptance reserves the item. A lending proposal additionally requires a start that is not before the current time and an end at least five seconds after it. Inside one transaction the buyer is re-read and must be active, a duplicate active proposal by the same buyer for the listing is rejected, and the repository re-checks that the listing is live, matches the type, still has its seller, and has no competing accepted deal. On success the seller receives a "New Buyer Proposal" notification in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the signed-in buyer
      listingId - the listing being proposed for
      type - the listing type; must not be null
      price - the sale offer price, or null for borrow requests and claims
      start - the requested borrowing start, or null for non-borrow proposals
      end - the requested borrowing end, or null for non-borrow proposals
      Returns:
      the persisted proposal
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the type or listing id is missing, a borrowing period is invalid, the account is not an active buyer, a duplicate proposal exists, or the repository rejects the proposal
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • acceptCounter

      public void acceptCounter(User buyer, String id, long version) throws SQLException
      Accepts a seller counteroffer as the buyer.

      The deal must still be Countered at the supplied version and, for a borrowing counter, its period must not have expired. The deal becomes Accepted, the listing moves from Live to Reserved, competing open proposals are cancelled and their buyers notified, and the seller receives a "Counteroffer Accepted" notification. All changes commit together.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the signed-in buyer who owns the proposal
      id - the deal identifier
      version - the row version shown to the buyer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version is invalid or stale, the buyer is not active or not the owner, the status is no longer Countered, the counter period expired, or the listing changed
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • complete

      public void complete(User buyer, String id, long version) throws SQLException
      Completes an accepted sale or giveaway claim as the buyer.

      Borrowing deals cannot be completed through this method; use returnBorrowed(User, String, long). The deal becomes Completed, the reserved listing becomes Sold for a sale or Given for a giveaway, and the seller is notified in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the signed-in buyer who owns the deal
      id - the deal identifier
      version - the row version shown to the buyer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version is invalid or stale, the buyer is not active or not the owner, the deal is not an accepted purchase or claim, or the listing changed
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • returnBorrowed

      public void returnBorrowed(User buyer, String id, long version) throws SQLException
      Marks an accepted borrowing as returned by the buyer.

      The deal must be an accepted lending deal whose borrowing period has started. The deal becomes Returned, the reserved listing becomes Live again, and the seller is notified in the same transaction.

      Parameters:
      buyer - the signed-in buyer who owns the deal
      id - the deal identifier
      version - the row version shown to the buyer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the version is invalid or stale, the buyer is not active or not the owner, the deal is not an accepted borrowing, the borrowing has not started yet, or the listing changed
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • returnDueBorrowings

      public int returnDueBorrowings() throws SQLException
      Returns every due borrowing whose period has ended.

      Safe to run repeatedly: each candidate is re-locked and re-checked in its own transaction, so a stale candidate is skipped. An accepted lending deal with a due time at or before the clock is changed to Returned, its listing returns to Live, the buyer is notified, and the seller is notified.

      Returns:
      the number of borrowings returned by this run
      Throws:
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; each failed transaction is rolled back

    • remindDueBorrowings

      public void remindDueBorrowings() throws SQLException
      Sends one "Borrowing Due Soon" reminder per borrowing due within the next day.

      Each candidate is re-locked and re-checked. A deterministic notification id is derived from the deal id and checked for existence, so repeated or concurrent runs do not duplicate the reminder.

      Throws:
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; each failed transaction is rolled back
